review.title: DS compliance audit
review.intro: DS: {ds} (`{bundle}`), stack `{stack}`. Static scan; no browser run yet.
review.scanned: Scanned {files} files, {lines} lines of app CSS.
review.legend: Levels: Pass = no finding; Note = waits for a decision; Deviation = breaks a hard rule of the DS (`rules.md`, stack rules).
review.res.tokens_none: no embedded DS region and no import of the DS bundle found
review.row.metrics: Hard-coded font size, radius, spacing, shadow
review.res.tailwind: {n} arbitrary values ({colors} colours); {palette} default-palette colour classes
review.res.override: {rules} rules touch visual properties of DS classes; {same} selectors equal to DS selectors with different content; {important} `!important` ({copied} verbatim DS rules excluded)
review.res.components: {used} of {roots} DS root classes used; {unknown} unknown variants; {native}/{total} native controls without a DS or local class
review.res.local: {total} registry entries ({status}), {pending} undecided; {blocks} local blocks in files, {unregistered} without an entry
review.b.missing: DS tokens not embedded in the app ({n}), e.g. {list}
review.b.changed: Tokens with a value different from the DS ({n}), e.g. {list}
review.b.redefined: Tokens redefined outside the DS region ({n}): {list}
review.b.same_selector: Selectors equal to DS selectors with different content (old version or override): {list}
review.b.unknown_mods: Variants found neither in the DS nor in the app: {list}
review.b.native: Native controls without a DS class or local class: {list}
review.b.theming_unknown: `{attr}` set to values the DS does not declare: {list}
review.b.local_unregistered: Local blocks without a registry entry: {list}
review.map.title: Proposed mapping of hard-coded values to DS tokens
review.map.intro: Proposal only; the app is not changed. Token values come from the default configuration of {ds} (plain `:root`, light). When you replace a value, keep DOM, classes, text and behaviour as they are.
review.map.note.alpha: alpha {a}: check Figma (overlay or translucent token)
review.map.note.pill: fully rounded: use a pill/full radius token if the DS has one
review.map.note.primitive: only the primitive {token} matches; no semantic token
review.map.note.scale_extra: spacing scale; {n} component tokens share the value
review.map.note.check_role: same value, check the text role
review.map.note.other_role: only {token} matches, a token of another role: check the meaning before reusing it
review.res.dsvue: {n} DS Vue components in `{package}`; {rebuilt} rebuilt locally; {shadcn} files import shadcn-vue components
review.b.dsvue_rebuilt: Local Vue files named like a DS Vue component (rebuilt instead of used) ({n}): {list}
review.b.dsvue_shadcn: Files that import shadcn-vue components although the DS has its own Vue layer ({n}): {list}
